title: Intent to Knock
alt: Four panels in a stairwell with pale walls, a green band along the stairs and a handrail. Panel 1: Margo, the tall caseworker in a mustard cardigan, climbs the concrete stairs with a Hollis note in one hand and a stack of forms under her arm. Pip, the small lavender candle-wisp, has floated up to the landing, where a plain grey-green door stands beside a big painted 5. Panel 2: On the landing Pip stands at the door with a hand raised to knock; Margo holds her arm out to stop them. Panel 3: Close-up of Margo, deadpan behind round glasses, holding up four forms fanned like playing cards, labelled 12, 12-B, 12-C and 12-D. Panel 4: Pip looks worried. A small grey puddle is seeping out from under the door and drops are falling by the gap. Margo is already a step back down the stairs, forms under her arm.
hover: Form 12-E is for knocking twice. Nobody has ever needed it.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: One flight. Only to show you there's nothing to see.
Panel 2 – MARGO: Nobody knocks. Form 12. Notice of Intent to Knock.
Panel 3 – MARGO: 12-B, the knock. 12-C, being let in. 12-D, being let out again.
Panel 4 – PIP: Margo. It's raining under the door.
Panel 4 – MARGO: Then it's a Medium problem.
note: Hollis said further. She went exactly one flight further. I drew my first stairwell for it, and it's grey on purpose. Something on the fifth floor is drizzling.
